Introducing Fashion Product Intelligence
 
Fashion intelligence, 
built into every product.
 
Most fashion retailers lose revenue to shallow product data: poor search, weak recommendations, underperforming ads. 
Mapp Fashion fixes this at the source, by enriching your entire catalogue with 26,000+ stylist-curated attributes so the same product intelligence powers every channel.
 
 
Mapp Fashion →

Analytics

 Mapp Fashion helps brands deliver AI-driven personalization and inventory insights to improve eCommerce efficiency and boost your brand’s revenue.

Automation
 Deliver personalized, cross-channel experiences across email, SMS, app, and web that adapt to each customer’s behavior and guide them seamlessly through all relevant digital touchpoints.

Hear what our customers have to say
 
 
 
 
 
 
From Retail & eCommerce to Finance and Publishing, Mapp Marketing Cloud helps more than 3,000 businesses from across diverse industries.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Our partnership helps us put customers at the heart of everything, delivering personalized recommendations and outfits to offer the best experience. We’ve seen strong results and I’m excited to roll it out across all brands.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Integrating our data and automating personalized customer journeys have significantly boosted our engagement rates and improved our email marketing performance. Insights from Mapp have enabled us to connect more deeply with our customers, increasing loyalty and growth. Now, our team can concentrate on strategic initiatives instead of manual, time-consuming tasks.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
At PizzaExpress, we've been on a journey to transform the way we engage with our customers through our industry leading loyalty app, PizzaExpress Club. Our partnership with Mapp has been instrumental in achieving exceptional results, from a significant increase in app downloads and loyalty members to the valuable insights we've gained on customer behaviour. We never stand still at PizzaExpress and are working on leveraging this data to further enhance real-time personalisation, resulting in better-customised journeys to our customers.

Trust Center
 
 
 
 
 Overview
 
 Security Measures
 
 Data Protection
 
 AI Usage
 
 
 
 
Our Commitment to Security and Data Protection
 
At Mapp, we’re dedicated to keeping your data safe. Mapp Engage, Mapp Intelligence and Mapp Fashion are designed to help you connect with customers securely. We know that your trust is earned through transparency and robust security measures.
ISO 27001 Certified: 
Our information security management is certified under ISO 27001, including cloud-specific standards such as ISO 27017 (Cloud Security) and ISO 27018 (Cloud Privacy).
Additional Standards: 
We adhere to ISO 27701 for privacy management and ISO 22301 for business continuity, ensuring our services remain reliable even in disruptive situations.
Compliance: 
We meet key global regulatory standards, including GDPR, CCPA, NIS-2, and DORA.
Certified Sender Alliance: 
We follow the best practices in email marketing, ensuring both security and deliverability.
Independent Audits: 
Regular third-party audits and penetration tests help us continually strengthen our defenses and improve our security measures.
 
 
 
Key Security Measures
 
Hosting: 
Mapp Engage and Intelligence run in ISO 27001 certified data centers in Germany. Mapp Fashion is hosted on AWS in EU regions by default. This keeps your data secure and ensures it resides within EU boundaries.
Data Encryption:
 We use AES-256 encryption to protect sensitive data at rest and TLS 1.2+ for secure data transmission, safeguarding your data per state of the art.
Identity & Access Management:
 Multi-Factor Authentication and Role-based Access Control, as well as the option for Single Sign-On, ensure only authorized people can access your data. We review permissions regularly.
Vulnerability Management:
 Regular vulnerability scans and annual penetration testing help identify and fix risks. Redacted reports available on request.
Incident Response:
 Our 24/7 team responds swiftly to incidents, with regular drills and breach notifications sent within 24 hours.
 
 
 
Data Protection Features
 
Custom Data Collection: 
Collect only what you need for specific marketing purposes.
First-Party Analytics:
 100% GDPR-compliant tracking, no reliance on third-party data.
Flexible Web Tracking: 
Choose between client-side (cookies) or server-side tracking for more control.
Email Tracking: 
Customize based on user consent – personalized, anonymized, or none.
Manage Consent & Rights:
 Easily handle requests for access, corrections, or opt-outs.
Data Ownership: 
You control your data with full legal guarantees.
What happens in Europe will stay in Europe:
 Upon request, we will limit access to your data to the European Union and the United Kingdom.
Privacy by Design:
 Privacy and security are built into our product features from the beginning using threat modelling techniques.
 
 
 
Responsible AI Usage
 
Customer-Specific AI Models: 
We use machine learning models tailored to your data, ensuring you retain full control.
AI Assistant: 
Our optional AI Assistant helps with tasks like content creation, always prioritizing privacy and compliance.
No Personal Data Shared: 
We never transmit personal data to AI services.
Full Transparency: 
You can always see what data is shared, ensuring clarity.
Safe AI Outputs:
 AI outputs are regularly reviewed to ensure accuracy and prevent bias.
